title: Caustic Soda Flakes
description: Sodium hydroxide flakes (98–99% NaOH) for saponification, soap manufacturing, water treatment, and industrial pH adjustment in Oman.

details.longDescription: Caustic Soda Flakes (Sodium Hydroxide Flakes) supplier in Oman — Global Chemicals LLC is a leading caustic soda supplier in Muscat, Oman, supplying high-purity sodium hydroxide flakes (98–99% NaOH) to soap manufacturers, water treatment plants, food processors, textile industries, and oil & gas operators across Oman. Caustic soda flakes are the most widely used form of sodium hydroxide for saponification (soap making), as the flake form is easy to handle, weigh, dissolve, and store. The flakes dissolve rapidly in water to produce concentrated caustic solution. Key applications include soap and detergent manufacturing (saponification of fats and oils), water treatment pH adjustment (raising alkalinity in drinking water and wastewater), aluminium processing (bauxite digestion), textile scouring, paper and pulp bleaching, food processing (olive curing, pretzels), and chemical synthesis. Global Chemicals LLC supplies caustic soda flakes in 25kg bags and 1,000kg super sacks. Technical grade (98% purity) and food-grade (suitable for food contact applications) available. SDS, CoA, and TDS supplied with every batch. Delivery to Muscat (same day for orders before 12 PM), Sohar, Salalah, Duqm, Nizwa, and Sur within 2–3 business days. Export to UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, and Bahrain.
applications: Water treatment pH adjustment and alkalinity control
Food processing (olive curing, pretzel glazing, noodle production)

title: Caustic Soda Liquid
description: Liquid sodium hydroxide solution (30–50% NaOH) for industrial cleaning, water treatment, and continuous-process manufacturing in Oman.

details.longDescription: Caustic Soda Liquid (Sodium Hydroxide Solution) supplier in Oman — Global Chemicals LLC supplies liquid caustic soda in 30%, 48%, and 50% concentration grades to water treatment plants, chemical manufacturers, food processors, and industrial facilities across Muscat and Oman. Liquid caustic soda is preferred over flakes or prills for continuous dosing applications, automated chemical feed systems, and large-volume consumption where manual dissolving would be impractical. In water treatment, liquid caustic is widely used for pH correction in municipal drinking water plants, swimming pool pH raising, and industrial effluent neutralization. In food processing, food-grade liquid caustic soda (30% solution) is used for olive curing, pretzel baking, and CIP (Clean-in-Place) cleaning of food processing equipment. Industrial applications include pulp and paper cooking, textile processing, aluminium surface treatment, and petroleum refining (acid neutralization). Global Chemicals LLC stocks liquid caustic soda in 25L jerricans, 200L HDPE drums, and 1,000L IBC containers, with bulk tanker delivery available to major industrial customers. Technical and food-grade certificates available. Same-day delivery in Muscat, next-day to Sohar and Salalah.
applications: Swimming pool pH raising and alkalinity control

title: Caustic Soda Prills
description: High-purity sodium hydroxide prills (99% NaOH) — low-dust, free-flowing beads for precise dosing in detergent formulation and industrial processes in Oman.

details.longDescription: Caustic Soda Prills (Sodium Hydroxide Prills/Beads) supplier in Oman — Global Chemicals LLC supplies high-purity caustic soda prills (99% NaOH) in Muscat, Oman. Caustic soda prills are spherical beads of sodium hydroxide produced by a prilling process, offering lower dust generation compared to flakes, improved flow properties for automated dispensing systems, and marginally higher purity (99% vs 98% for flakes). The prills form is preferred by industrial chemical formulators, pharmaceutical-grade operations, and manufacturers requiring precise automated weighing and dosing. Applications include industrial detergent and cleaning product formulation, chemical synthesis requiring precise NaOH quantities, laboratory applications, food-grade pH adjustment, and niche applications where low dust and free-flowing characteristics are required. Like caustic soda flakes, the prills dissolve readily in water to form sodium hydroxide solution at any required concentration. Global Chemicals LLC supplies caustic soda prills in 25kg bags and 500kg big bags. Purity certificate, CoA, SDS, and TDS provided. Same-day delivery in Muscat, next-day delivery to Sohar, Salalah, and other Oman locations.

Precise chemical synthesis and pH adjustment
Water treatment (where low-dust handling is required)
